title: The sprint owns paths in sc-agent-types, sc-agent-http, sc-decision-schema, sc-jev-check, sc-jev-host, sc-ai and sc-jev-py
description: The sprint owns paths in sc-agent-types, sc-agent-http, sc-decision-schema, sc-jev-check, sc-jev-host, sc-ai and sc-jev-py. The `requirements` list names only some of each crate's ids. Missing: sc-agent-types REQ-SAG-0101, 0103, 0120, 0121, 0147, 0148 (NFR-SAG-0001 is listed). sc-agent-http REQ-SAG-0505. sc-decision-schema REQ-SAG-0140, 0141, 0142, 0144, 0145 (0146 and 0103 are covered). sc-jev-check REQ-SAG-0300, 0301, 0302, 0303, 0305, 0309, 0311, 0312, 0313, 0314, 0503, 0601, 0602, 0603, 0620. sc-jev-host REQ-SAG-0604, 0605 (plus any other ids in that file, which I only partly listed). sc-ai REQ-SAG-0702, 0703, 0710, 0712, 0900 (NFR-SAG-0001 and REQ-SAG-0604/0605 appear in that file's references). sc-jev-py REQ-SAG-0803, 0604, 0605. The plan states 'Every id a sprint's files touch is in its requirements: list', and the run loop, session store, compose and the whole sc-jev-check/src/** tree are in this sprint's owned paths. The ids that are not `req:` roots would also need a regression command in the boundary row.
